en-US.description:
🍞 Frequency Coffee Aldgate

Let's keep this a secret between us? They have a limited number of sandwiches...
This is the cafe I've been thinking about every time I open my eyes these days. The atmosphere is great,
and the prices are really reasonable, and the portions are generous. ㅠ
It's the best sandwich I've had in London.
I go here so often that I might even see myself.
I'm only going to open it once. (Don't spread rumors‼️)

🩷London Zoo (£25 per person on weekdays / £35 per person on weekends)

Animal welfare is the top priority, and the purpose isn't just for exhibitions.
Proceeds go to the conservation and protection of endangered species.
I kept putting it off, but a friend recommended it, and I went.
It brought me back to my childhood. 🥹
As I watched, I realized that if an animal is sleeping, you have to let it sleep,
you can't hit the glass windows,
and there are quiet areas, dark areas, etc.
I really enjoyed seeing the rules for non-human animals everywhere.
